client_note: A measurable is judged on its three most recent weeks that have a score (empty weeks are skipped). Off-track means most of those three missed the goal (for example 2 of 3), at-risk means some but not most missed, and on-track means none missed. The average is shown but does not drive the status. This is close to Ninety's 'missed 3 of the last 3' idea, but off-track triggers at 2 of 3. Let us know if you'd prefer the stricter 3-of-3 rule.
resolution: Current rule reported; requesting S/J input on 2-of-3 (current) vs Ninety's 3-of-3.
resolution_ste: Follow-up. The app examines the last 3 weeks that have a score. If 2 or 3 of these weeks miss the goal, the measurable is off-track. If 1 week misses the goal, the measurable is at-risk. Tell us if you prefer "3 of 3".
